name: air squat (version 2)
source_instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel with chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
interpretation: One complete controlled five-second arms-forward squat. Shoulder-width feet with modest12degree toes-out remain supported. Hips move back and down to parallel, with chest up and knees following the stance. Arms reach forward30degrees below world horizontal with relaxed10degree elbow flexion and softly articulated fingers. This arm height is an authored compatible balance choice for both canonical texts; neither specifies numerical shoulder height. The return exactly closes the loop. No stretch hold applies.
